title: infra-scanner Findings
description: Canonical intermediate format produced by every infra-scanner scanner and consumed by report-writer.

fix.description: Remediation guidance attached to this finding. The 'before'/'after' fields are populated for mechanically-fixable findings (so the report can show a concrete diff). The 'mechanically_fixable' flag controls whether fix-writer is allowed to propose a PR for this change when --fix is passed. Nothing is ever auto-applied to source — delivery is always via a draft PR for human review.

mechanically_fixable.description: True only for categories where fix-writer can compute a correct patch by template without human judgment: iac-config-flag (Terraform/Kubernetes boolean swaps) and action-pin (pinning a GitHub Action to a commit SHA). False for open ingress, public DB, hardcoded creds, secret-in-ENV, curl|bash, latest-tag, ADD-url, and workflow-injection findings — these stay as report guidance only and never get a PR. Note: 'mechanically' does not mean 'auto-applied' — even when true, the delivery is a draft PR that a human merges.

root_cause.description: One-sentence explanation of why this is a misconfiguration.

command.description: Shell command to apply the fix when applicable, e.g. 'gh api repos/actions/checkout/commits/v4 --jq .sha'. Empty for pure code-edit fixes (iac-config-flag).

before.description: Misconfigured snippet (loaded from the finding location line). Empty when the finding is guide-only.

after.description: Fixed version of the same snippet. For action-pin this is a placeholder until fix-writer resolves the SHA.

verification.description: Imperative step to confirm the fix worked (e.g. 're-run /infra-scan --authorized; IAC-K8S-PRIVILEGED no longer reported').

applied.description: Set to true by fix-writer when a PR has been successfully opened for this finding. 'Applied' here means 'PR proposed' — not 'merged'.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when fix-writer opened the PR. Null until proposed.

pr_url.description: URL of the draft PR fix-writer opened for this finding. Populated only when status was 'pr-opened'. Null otherwise — including when status was 'branch-pushed-no-pr' (no CLI available) or 'branch-only' (push failed).

pr_branch.description: Branch name fix-writer created for the PR (e.g. 'infra-fix/iac-k8s-privileged'). Populated whenever the worktree + commit step succeeded, even if push or PR-open later failed.
